component.name: Drop Desktop Client
component.summary: Client for the open-source, self-hosted Drop game platform

description.p: Drop is an open-source, self-hosted game distribution platform. This is the desktop client used to browse a Drop server, download and update games, and launch them.
Native Linux games can be run directly. Windows games can be run through Proton/umu-launcher, and native games can optionally be run inside the Steam Linux Runtime.
